result.description: A fictional compact studio controller designed for archival kiosks and museum interactives, the Nebula Forge Axiom 12 pairs a silent ARM-based control module with deterministic I/O for lighting, sensor triggers, and looped media playback. It is built for educational exhibits and retail signage where low power draw, simple deployment, and long service intervals matter more than raw graphics performance. The unit ships with 128 GB embedded flash, dual USB-C service ports, and optional wall-mount hardware.
result.title: Nebula Forge Axiom 12
result.title_description: Compact media control appliance for kiosks and exhibits
